title: EDG Community Update: Week of November 1st
body:
**Highlights**
- Introducing [‘Feature Requests’ functionality](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1455280569265410051?s=20) on the governance forum.
- Edgeware Agency claimed [Polkadot’s ParaID #2014](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1456359717098426370?s=20).
- [The waitlist is now open for Kabocha](https://www.kabocha.network/), the Kusama parachain from the Edgeware ecosystem.
- All validators are requested to upgrade their nodes to the [release v3.3.3 or later](https://github.com/hicommonwealth/edgeware-node/releases) to proceed further with the ERUP4/Wako upgrade through the on-chain governance. The core community dev Ramsey recently shared [the docker image for v3.3.3 aka ERUP4/Wako upgrade](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1438226365833175048?s=20) to save the compiling hustle for node/validator owners.
- Get to know more technical oriented updates on the ‘[Developer Update aka EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-developer-update-oct-31/)’.


**Ecosystem Updates**
- Community members interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink’s oracle nodes on Edgeware, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)’s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.
- Kylin Network’s [DataWarehouse v0 is now live](https://twitter.com/Kylin_Network/status/1457049110767362060?s=20).


**Governance**
- Referendum 51: Treasury funding proposal to fund ‘Dashboard for Edgeware Treasury’ by OpenSquare {Referendum type: SimpleMajority, ​​Council Motion ID:56, Treasury Proposal ID:40}


**Community**
- The Calendar of events has many items each week, meetings on NFTs, DAOs, chain strategy and governance- whatever you're interested in, [take a look](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/1059-edgeware-community-calendar-add-to-your-gcal).
- Recent/trending Community Research thread(s):
- [Obtain a DOT ParaID](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/241
